Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:

  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Jennifer Martin (E033) is a contractor Analyst with basic security training. Contractors can never be granted admin; without advanced training, maximum access is read. Requested admin exceeds this, so recommend read.

content.text:
Let me work through this ticket.

Employee: Jennifer Martin (E033)
Role: Analyst
Employment type: contractor
Security training: basic
Requested: admin access to Payroll

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

This contractor has basic training (not advanced), so maximum is read.

Requested admin > maximum read, so grant maximum = read.

Both HR and Security recommend read. Grant read.
